program:
app "Table tennis" ball plum
table point team pick Home|Away, pts num 1..500 = 1
let a = sum(point.pts where team = Home)
let b = sum(point.pts where team = Away)
row gap 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Home" bold
    a big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Home, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+10" tap add point team = Home, pts = 10
  stack card grow align center
    "Away" bold
    b big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Away, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+10" tap add point team = Away, pts = 10
button "Undo" tap remove last(point)
button "New game" tap remove all point
"Lead:" abs(a - b) faint
list point
describe:
Table tennis, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- point: team: one of Home, Away; pts: number, 1 to 500, starts at 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- a is the total pts of point where team is Home.
- b is the total pts of point where team is Away.
Shows:
- text: "Home".
- text: a.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Home, pts set to 1.
- a button "+10"; a tap adds a point with team set to Home, pts set to 10.
- text: "Away".
- text: b.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Away, pts set to 1.
- a button "+10"; a tap adds a point with team set to Away, pts set to 10.
- a button "Undo"; a tap removes the latest point entries, with undo.
- a button "New game"; a tap removes all point entries, with one undo.
- text: "Lead:", a minus b without its sign.
- a list of point; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
hurried_style: a short question, 4 to 10 words
fuller_style: two sentences, 20 to 35 words
order: start with the problem or reason

table goal_scored
setting target num = 20

draw width 240 tap add goal_scored
  circle 44 stroke soft thick 8
  arc 44, 0, 360 * clamp(n / target, 0, 1) stroke accent thick 8
  label 50, 46, n big
  label 50, 64, "of" target faint
button "Undo" tap remove last(goal_scored today)
stat count(goal_scored), "all time"
remind "Time for goals" every 3h from 8:00 to 20:00

program:
app "Errands" pin plum
table errand title text, done bool, tag pick Bank|Post|Shop|Other = Bank, priority pick Low|Normal|High = Normal
count(errand where done = no) "open" head
each errand where done = no sort priority desc as t
  row card gap 2 tap edit t swipe remove t
    toggle t.done
    stack grow
      t.title bold
      t.tag faint
form errand
"Done" faint
list errand where done = yes
button "Clear done" tap remove all errand where done = yes
describe:
Errands, in the plum colours.
